tools.name: compact
tools.description: Ask a session to summarise itself, then continue it in a new session file that points back at it (fork, DESIGN §11). The old file is never changed except by the two turns this writes into it. Returns the new session id.

session.description: The session to compact; it must not be running a step.

focus.description: Extra emphasis for the brief. Supplements the required sections, never replaces them.

max_steps.description: Steps the summarising run may take (1-3, default 1).
